3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: It was a dark, chilly evening when Petr called and asked if we could meet. He gave no details -- all he said was that it was important.

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: I drove alone through Holsord's suburbs until I reached the meeting point he named: 147 Wruhec Avenue, number 26. Our old campaign headquarters, untouched since the night of the election. This was where everything began.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: I made my way up the dusty staircase of the office building. The light in the second-floor hallway was out, so I used a cigarette lighter to find my way to the wooden door marked 26. I pulled on the handle, but it wouldn't budge. The heavy door had always been a pain to open.

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: Petr pushed on the door with all his weight. It made a screeching sound as it opened.

8.speaker: Petr Vectern
8.text: “Without further ado, I bid you welcome to this grand nostalgia trip, hosted by yours truly, Petr Vectern!"

11.speaker: Player
11.text: “Indeed. I haven't been to this place in ages!”

12.speaker: Narrator
12.text: He made an exaggerated bow. The dust from the opened door was still settling down.

13.speaker: Player
13.text: “I remember it as being much cleaner.”

14.speaker: Petr Vectern
14.text: “That's what time does to things, my friend. You're looking a little shabbier yourself than you did back then."

15.speaker: Petr Vectern
15.text: “Well, I for one am overflowing with nostalgia.”

16.speaker: Petr Vectern
16.text: “I miss it sometimes. Even that damn door.”

18.speaker: Narrator
18.text: He walked over to his old desk and pointed to the gramophone that had annoyed our neighbors and kept us company for so many late nights. Petr filpped the switch, and it filled the room with swing music from the '20s.

21.speaker: Player
21.text: “Are you going to tell me why we are here?”

22.speaker: Player
22.text: “I thought this office was sold off.”

24.speaker: Petr Vectern
24.text: “No, I've been paying the rent. Too many memories attached to this place just to sell it. And you know, we might use it again soon..."

26.speaker: Narrator
26.text: He put his hand under the desk and brought a bottle out. He took a swig out of it and passed the bottle to me.

29.speaker: Petr Vectern
29.text: “Palace life is pampering you too much. Just drink from the bottle like the old days. Remember where we come from.”

31.speaker: Narrator
31.text: Petr snapped his fingers to the music while going through the items in the room. It looked virtually unchanged since election night.

32.speaker: Petr Vectern
32.text: “Come on, have a look around. See if it doesn't bring back memories."

33.speaker: Player_Italic
33.text: Go through the records next to the gramophone.

49.speaker: Petr Vectern
49.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn07_P_OldOffice_Records"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn07_P_OldOffice_Boxes"] == true  or Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn07_P_OldOffice_Drawers"] == true) == false

52.speaker: Narrator
52.text: Inside, there were a few old coins, pencils and sheets of paper. Underneath them, something caught my eye.

53.speaker: Narrator
53.text: It was a photograph of me and Monica, sitting under a tree. This must've been 10, maybe 15 years ago. We looked so young and so happy. Monica would love to see this.

54.speaker: Petr Vectern
54.text: “Nice find. Look at baby Anton! You didn't even have your iconic look.”

57.speaker: Narrator
57.text: In one of the storage boxes, I found a heavy object, wrapped safely. I unwrapped it.

58.speaker: Narrator
58.text: It was an emerald-colored statue of a goat, the symbol of Sordland. I remembered that this was a gift from Brenda: one of the '53 election campaign assistants. It would look good on my desk in the palace.

59.speaker: Petr Vectern
59.text: “Brenda, Brenda, Brenda. Always sucking up to you, and where did it get her? Seriously, where? I have no idea where she ended up."

62.speaker: Narrator
62.text: I found one of my favourite albums ever: Mountains by Janit Gurz. A set of plaintive folk songs that made me yearn for the countryside whenever I heard it.

63.speaker: Petr Vectern
63.text: “What a classic! You should mail that to Franc so he can learn what real music is.”

72.speaker: Player
72.text: “You said you wanted to talk about something on the phone.”

73.speaker: Player
73.text: “You called me here just for nostalgia?”

74.speaker: Player
74.text: “Don't tell me Petr Vectern is getting sappy in his old age.”

75.speaker: Petr Vectern
75.text: “Yes. Erm, no. We'll talk about it. All in good time."

76.speaker: Petr Vectern
76.text: “Not that old! But yes, it happens to the best of us.”

77.speaker: Narrator
77.text: He gestured to the bottle he had in his hand.

80.speaker: Narrator
80.text: He shrugged, took a very big gulp out of the bottle and staggered to the side afterwards.

81.speaker: Narrator
81.text: He took a very big gulp out of the bottle and staggered to the side afterwards.

84.speaker: Player
84.text: “I know you, Petr. What are you hiding?”

85.speaker: Petr Vectern
85.text: “Yeah. Yeah, I'm okay. Let's go up to the roof. The view was always amazing from there.”

86.speaker: Petr Vectern
86.text: “Let's go up to the roof. The view was always amazing from there.”

87.speaker: Petr Vectern
87.text: “Nothing. Let's go up to the roof. The view was always amazing from there.”

88.speaker: Narrator
88.text: We went up the stairs to the roof. The view was mesmerizing. The buildings of Holsord twinkled below us, while the stars shone bright in the sky.

89.speaker: Narrator
89.text: We sat and leaned back against a wall, taking it all in.

90.speaker: Narrator
90.text: Right as I was starting to get up, I heard a sobbing sound. I turned to Petr and saw tears streaming down his cheeks.

93.speaker: Player
93.text: “I've not yet seen a night sky beautiful enough to make Petr Vectern cry.”

94.speaker: Narrator
94.text: He wiped the tears away and laughed.

96.speaker: Petr Vectern
96.text: “I messed up Anton. I messed up big time.”

97.speaker: Petr Vectern
97.text: "Evelyn's leaving me. She wants a divorce."

99.speaker: Player
99.text: “You two have always had rough patches. I'm sure you'll kiss and make up."

105.speaker: Petr Vectern
105.text: “I know, she's your secretary. I'm so sorry."

106.speaker: Player
106.text: “I had a feeling about you two.”

107.speaker: Petr Vectern
107.text: “We got careless, I know. I'm so sorry.”

108.speaker: Player
108.text: “Shit. What if this causes a scandal?”

109.speaker: Petr Vectern
109.text: “It won't. I'll keep it all under wraps. I'm so sorry."

110.speaker: Player
110.text: “How could you do this to me?”

111.speaker: Player
111.text: “I will be blunt. You will fix this or I will remove you from office."

112.speaker: Petr Vectern
112.text: “Yes Anton. I understand. Thank you so much."

113.speaker: Player
113.text: “All right. It's just an affair, and it's over at that. We can weather this."

114.speaker: Player
114.text: “You've done enough damage. I will handle it myself.”

115.speaker: Petr Vectern
115.text: “Thank you, Anton. That means a lot to me."

116.speaker: Narrator
116.text: Without waiting for his reaction, I left the rooftop alone and made my way downstairs.

120.speaker: Narrator
120.text: On my way out, I grabbed my belongings and took one last look back at the office. It had been home to some happy memories for sure, but this visit had permanently cured me of any nostalgia.
120.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_P_TookPhotograph"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_P_TookRecord"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_P_TookStatue"] == true

121.speaker: Narrator
121.text: On my way out, I took one last look back at the office. It had been home to some happy memories for sure, but this visit had permanently cured me of any nostalgia.
121.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_P_TookPhotograph"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_P_TookRecord"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_P_TookStatue"] == true) == false

122.speaker: Narrator
122.text: As soon as I arrived home, I headed up to my study, sat down and stared at the telephone.

123.speaker: Player_Italic
123.text: Call Lucian and tell him what happened.

124.speaker: Player_Italic
124.text: Trust Petr and call no one.

125.speaker: Narrator
125.text: I stared at the receiver, wondering what his last statement meant. What was going on that I didn't know about?

128.speaker: Narrator
128.text: I told Lucian everything Petr had told me about himself, Evelyn and Livia.

133.speaker: Narrator
133.text: It was a photograph of me and Monica, sitting under a tree. This must've been 10, maybe 15 years ago. Her expression in it sent pangs through my heart. I couldn't even imagine her looking at me that way now.

134.speaker: Player
134.text: “Enough going through old stuff. Let's talk.”

135.speaker: Player
135.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn07_P_OldOffice_Records"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn07_P_OldOffice_Boxes"] == true  or Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn07_P_OldOffice_Drawers"] == true) == false

140.speaker: Lucian Galade
140.text: “Thank you for calling me, Mr. President. This serves to confirm some suspicions of my own. We have to meet.”

143.speaker: Petr Vectern
143.text: “It's just, Evelyn hasn't been the same since she lost her job, and Livia was giving me sultry looks from the day I hired her..."

144.speaker: Petr Vectern
144.text: “You were away, I was drunk, one thing led to another."

145.speaker: Petr Vectern
145.text: "But she's more than just a pretty girl, Anton! She's smart and kind... I think we really connected."

146.speaker: Player
146.text: "I like her, too. That doesn't mean I'd break my vows and risk a scandal for a bit of horizontal polo!"

147.speaker: Player
147.text: "Don't tell me you're going to run off with her!"

148.speaker: Petr Vectern
148.text: "No, no. We're ending things. I told her it's too unprofessional. And I want Evelyn back."

149.speaker: Petr Vectern
149.text: "I know, I know. But we're ending things. I told her it's too unprofessional. And I want Evelyn back."

151.speaker: Player
151.text: "Well, maybe I can speak to Evelyn and plead your case."

152.speaker: Player
152.text: "It's too late. There's still a chance this could get out. I need to talk to Lucian."

153.speaker: Player
153.text: "I still can't believe this. I ought to have you both fired."

154.speaker: Player
154.text: "Who else knows besides me and the three of you?"

157.speaker: Narrator
157.text: There was an edge of desperation in Petr's voice. He took another drink.

158.speaker: Petr Vectern
158.text: "How many years have we known each other? How many scrapes have we gotten ourselves out of? I can handle this myself. Just trust me and don't bring anyone else into this."

160.speaker: Player
160.text: "Of course I would. What evidence does she have of the affair?"

161.speaker: Player
161.text: "No, I'd do it for my administration. How did Evelyn find out?"

162.speaker: Petr Vectern
162.text: "She wrote me a rather saucy note. I made the mistake of putting it in my pants pocket on laundry day."

163.speaker: Player
163.text: "Just words. We'll find a way to spin it."

164.speaker: Player
164.text: "That's the kind of stupidity that ends presidencies."

165.speaker: Player
165.text: "I've known Evelyn almost as long as you. I'll talk some sense into her."

167.speaker: Petr Vectern
167.text: "I don't deserve you. Either of you. Thank you for this, Anton."

170.speaker: Player
170.text: "Don't mention it. I mean it -- *don't mention it*."

172.speaker: Narrator
172.text: I turned to face my friend and Vice President. The habits that had gotten him dubbed the "bad boy of Sordish politics" when we were young were no longer so charming coming from a middle-aged man. Yet he was still a capable politician, and I couldn't ignore our long history together.

175.speaker: Player
175.text: "Don't mention it. I mean it -- *don't mention it*."

179.speaker: Lucian Galade
179.text: "Tomorrow morning in your office. Early, before either of the two arrive."

180.speaker: Lucian Galade
180.text: "I'd rather discuss this in person. Tomorrow morning in your office. Early, before either of the two arrive."

181.speaker: Lucian Galade
181.text: "Yes, but early, before either of the two arrive."

182.speaker: Lucian Galade
182.text: "Don't bring this up with anyone else. I fear we may have more than a mere dalliance on our hands."

183.speaker: Narrator
183.text: I went to bed, but couldn't sleep at all.

184.speaker: Narrator
184.text: I slipped into bed, careful not to disturb my sleeping wife. Petr and Evelyn hadn't made it -- were we next? I hadn't cheated on her, but what I had done was arguably worse...

188.speaker: Narrator
188.text: I couldn't sleep at all that night.

189.speaker: Narrator
189.text: I slipped into bed, careful not to disturb my sleeping wife. Petr and Evelyn hadn't made it -- were we next?

190.speaker: Narrator
190.text: I slipped into bed, careful not to disturb my sleeping wife. I would tell her the news about Petr and Evelyn tomorrow. I hoped it wouldn't upset her too much.

194.speaker: Narrator
194.text: Evelyn answered after a few rings.

195.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
195.text: "Anton, it's late. Is everything all right?"

196.speaker: Narrator
196.text: I told her what I knew about her, Petr and Livia.

198.speaker: Narrator
198.text: She was silent for so long I thought she might have hung up.

199.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
199.text: "Whatever you have to say, it won't change my mind."

200.speaker: Player
200.text: "Petr still loves you. He was in tears when we talked."

201.speaker: Player
201.text: "Don't you understand? Your jealousy could ruin my chances of re-election."

202.speaker: Player
202.text: "He's already ended it. Can't you forgive him?"

203.speaker: Player
203.text: "Evelyn, please. I didn't call to change your mind. I'm on your side."

205.speaker: Narrator
205.text: Evelyn gave a short, sharp laugh.

206.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
206.text: "Do you know Petr at all? Really know him?"

207.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
207.text: "Livia wasn't the first, and she won't be the last. There'll always be another beautiful young woman for him to prey on."

208.speaker: Player
208.text: "Preyed on? Livia was a willing participant."

209.speaker: Player
209.text: "That's not fair. Petr says they had a real connection.."

210.speaker: Player
210.text: "He has a wandering eye. You knew that when you married him."

211.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
211.text: "Was she? Look at whom he goes after. Secretaries. Kitchen staff. Aides -- remember Brenda?"

212.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
212.text: "What do they have in common? When the vice president asks them for sex, they might lose their job if they refuse."

213.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
213.text: "I thought I could help curb his worst impulses, but it obviously wasn't true. Look at whom he goes after. Secretaries. Kitchen staff. Aides -- remember Brenda?"

214.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
214.text: "He said that, did he? Look at whom he goes after. Secretaries. Kitchen staff. Aides -- remember Brenda?"

215.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
215.text: "I'd go to the media about this if I wasn't persona non grata at the Holsord Post. And if there was a shred of a chance I'd be taken seriously."

216.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
216.text: "But at the very least, I will no longer be an accomplice to his abuse of power. And frankly, Anton, neither should you."

217.speaker: Narrator
217.text: Evelyn hung up without waiting for me to respond. I took a minute to think over what she had said.

218.speaker: Player_Italic
218.text: Call Lucian and tell him what happened.

222.speaker: Player
222.text: "No need to justify. Men will be men, after all."

223.speaker: Petr Vectern
223.text: "I'm glad you understand. In any case, we're ending things. I told her it's too unprofessional. And I want Evelyn back."

225.speaker: Petr Vectern
225.text: “Thanks. I wish my wife saw it that way.”

290.speaker: Player
290.text: "I... I'm sorry. I don't know what to say."

291.speaker: Narrator
291.text: Evelyn gave a short, sharp laugh.

293.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
293.text: "You're his best friend, Anton. Don't tell me you had no idea what he was getting up to all this time."

294.speaker: Player
294.text: "You're right. He behaved despicably, and I did nothing to stop him."

295.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
295.text: "To be fair, neither did I. For years."

296.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
296.text: "But look at the women he goes after. Secretaries. Kitchen staff. Aides -- remember Brenda?"

297.speaker: Player
297.text: "I guess I didn't want to know."
